resources.string: Not installed. Gives Dashwheel the shell without root
Installed, not started. Open Shizuku to start it
In use: shell commands run through it
Shizuku runs the shell commands root would: moving app windows, the car app\'s switches, the volume keys. A rooted unit starts it at boot; another one starts it from the Shizuku app after each boot.
